citations.assessment: The primary text explicitly has Rabbi Nehorai report in Shemuel’s name. The commentator’s two-Nehorais inference remains an argument.
The matching article transmits precisely the Mana’ah–elder–Nehorai chain as attributed to Yuḥasin.

holds.raw: ר' מנאה משום זקן א' ומנו ר' נהוראי
holds.reason: The exact chain is repeated in Heilprin’s related entry through Yuḥasin. The present Berakhot text gives Bena’ah in the parallel elder chain and does not continue with Nehorai.
